title: Renewing the Mind
definition: Renewing the Mind is the Spirit-led transformation of thought, desire, discernment, and obedience through God's truth.
summary: Renewing the Mind is the Spirit's transformation of the believer's thinking through the truth of God's Word.
christFocus: Jesus Christ transforms His people by truth so they discern and do the will of God.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Renewing the mind is the Spirit-shaped transformation of how believers think according to God's truth. Scripture teaches that discipleship reaches thoughts, assumptions, desires, and judgments.

The renewed mind learns to resist the patterns of the world and to discern God's will. This renewal happens through Scripture, prayer, worship, obedience, and ongoing correction.

Jesus is the truth who reorders the believer's understanding of God, self, sin, suffering, and hope. The mind is renewed as it is brought under His Word.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because many battles begin with false beliefs, distorted desires, or lies that feel true. Renewing the mind helps believers replace deception with Scripture-shaped thinking, especially in recovery, anxiety, shame, and temptation.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Identify one lie or worldly pattern shaping your thoughts. Answer it with Scripture, pray for renewed understanding, and practice decisions that agree with God's truth rather than old mental pathways.
